editorial.name: Mozart AI
editorial.descriptionZh: AI 歌曲生成与制作工具，写一句想法就能出歌，站内接着做编辑、母带和音乐视频。这次抓取只拿到首屏截图，DOM 正文为空。
editorial.takeawayZh: 写一句想法，出成品歌并继续做母带和音乐视频
editorial.noteZh: 需要说明：这一条的 live.bodyText、live.heads 与 live.imgCount 全都是空的，浏览器渲染阶段没抓到 DOM 文本，以下内容全部取自同一张首屏截图。截图里页面是深色舞台背景，导航右侧是 Scout、Affiliates、Discord、Sign Up、Log In；中间一条发光胶囊写 Personas are live: make any song in your own voice。主标题是衬线大字 Make a Song You'll Love，副题写 Turn an idea into a song, edit it, master it, make a music video, and release it.。页脚位置上排着 Forbes、MUSIC BUSINESS WORLDWIDE、Billboard、music:)ally、tech.eu、BUSINESS INSIDER 六个媒体标；顶部促销条写 40% OFF、Ending soon 44m 20s、All plans from $7/mo，带 See plans 按钮。

reasons.statement: 交付物是音频成品：截图副标题写 Turn an idea into a song, edit it, master it, make a music video, and release it.，http.title 也自称 AI Song Generator & Music Maker。
归 video-motion-audio-creation 而非 image-vector-layout-creation：主产物是歌与母带（音频），音乐视频只是流程末端的一环，取覆盖音频的这一档更贴近。
